title: ConditionReading
description: Vendor-neutral single measurement of a condition parameter (snapshot or historical timeseries point). Verified via pi-collector (pi_snapshot / pi_timeseries on TimescaleDB). Non-numeric PI values (digital states) are stored as value=null with value_good=false, never as text.

timestamp.description: Event/measurement time from PI (snapshot source_timestamp maps here). Idempotency key with attribute_id

value.description: Numeric value; null for digital states / non-numeric values

units.description: Engineering unit abbreviation (PI UnitsAbbreviation or registry unit_of_measure). Present on snapshots; historical points resolve units via the parameter registry

collected_at.description: When the collector wrote the row (UTC)

web_id.description: PI WebId of the stream the reading came from, when carried alongside
